title: Switched SportsGameOdds off
body: SportsGameOdds was not accepted: it was not accepted on 3 fresh runners in a row (last: Refused (HTTP 403): this key is not accepted (your plan does not include the usa). The engine restarted it and tried 3 fresh GitHub runner(s). It is OFF now and stays off until you look at it: check its key and plan, then switch it back on in Settings › APIs (the ladder starts again).
